HediffDef.label: Nish'ta conditioning
HediffDef.description: A living Goa'uld conditioning organism has colonized the nervous system, leaving the victim exceptionally open to imposed loyalty and suggestion. The organism persists until killed by a sufficiently strong electrical shock or controlled medical deprogramming.

HediffDef.label: Nish'ta resistance
HediffDef.description: This pawn has survived electrical clearance of Nish'ta. The prior infection has left the nervous system resistant to renewed colonization by the same conditioning organism.
